description: This file defines a `CartProvider` class for managing shopping cart state in a Flutter application. It handles adding, removing, updating, and clearing cart items, and notifies listeners on changes.

classes.name: CartProvider
classes.description: A ChangeNotifier class managing the shopping cart state, including adding and removing items, updating quantities, and calculating total price.

methods.name: addToCart
methods.description: Adds a `MenuItem` to the cart; if it already exists, increments its quantity.

methods.name: removeFromCart
methods.description: Removes an item from the cart by its menu item ID.

methods.name: updateQuantity
methods.description: Updates the quantity of a specific cart item, only if the quantity is greater than zero.

methods.name: clearCart
methods.description: Clears all items from the cart.
